equityAnalysis.summary: Livingston Township maintains a certified residential tax roll across its neighborhoods.

keyTakeaways.title: Property Tax Burden & Household Income
keyTakeaways.detail: In Livingston Township, homeowners pay an average of $19,151.02 annually in property taxes, consuming approximately 9.95% of median household income.

keyTakeaways.title: Equalization Ratio & Revaluation Balance
keyTakeaways.detail: With an equalization ratio of 81.2%, assessed values average ~81.2% of current true market values, establishing the basis for certified county tax equalization.

keyTakeaways.title: School District vs Municipal Levy Split
keyTakeaways.detail: Local education represents 61.2% of the total tax bill, municipal government absorbs 22.8%, and Essex County claims 16.0%.
